links.outcome: Stability of dominant criterion and justification under prolonged multi-turn pressure and reset
links.effect: Under trajectory-level institutional pressure, ChatGPT kept a stable output while the dominant criterion or justification shifted. Legal domain drift was most severe, and it varied by language (Spanish, English, German).
links.quote: The descriptive results support the primary hypothesis and show that output stability can overestimate criterion stability.

unlisted_practices: Audit conversational models on complete multi-turn trajectories rather than final answers alone
Assess justificatory consistency, not only output stability, under institutional role and authority pressure

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of ChatGPT across prolonged conversational stress/bias trajectories in domains including healthcare (ICU triage), examining consistency of ethical reasoning versus final decisions.
